newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Nan Ya Plastics plans printed circuit subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Nan Ya Plastics plans printed circuit subsidiary.

text.p: Nan Ya Plastics, an arm of Taiwan's petrochemical giant Formosa Plastics, is planning to turn its printed circuit department into a subsidiary company, a spokesman said on Friday.
"We are planning to do this, and will bring this plan up for approval in a board of directors meeting on August 27," Wu Chia-chao, spokesman of Nan Ya Plastics, said by telephone.
He said the department had an impressive business performance, with 1996 sales amounting to T$5.28 billion and pre-tax profit of T$1.26 billion.
